sections.label: One Partner
sections.h2: Restaurant Consulting That Ends With the Work Done
body: Monarch Digital is an all-in-one, white-glove partner for restaurant owners. Our restaurant consulting starts with a walkthrough of your operation and ends with the work done: software built, training written, marketing running, and furniture and uniforms sourced.

You get one team that knows covers, turns, and prime cost, with one plan tying every system together. We build our own software and AI, so the hospitality technology in your restaurant fits the way you run service, and everything we build works alongside the POS you already use.

sections.label: Case Study
sections.h2: Everything a Private Dining Club in Vail Runs On, Built in About Seven Months
body: For a private dining club in Vail, Colorado, we built the member app, host stand, server tablets, kitchen screens, scheduling, a custom training academy, and 13 AI assistants. We also handled the website and marketing, coordinated the furniture, and managed the project. The public website was live within the first month, and the club opened about seven months after our first line of code. The same team and process scale down to a single dining room. See how we built it.

sections.label: Meet the Founder
sections.h2: Christy Renner Built Monarch to Help Owners Turn Vision Into Reality
body: Christy Renner, our Founder and CEO, grew up just outside Pittsburgh and built a career across manufacturing, operations, customer loyalty programs, community relations, and business development. After years of working alongside family-owned businesses in Tampa Bay, she created Monarch, named for a butterfly and a promise from a dear friend. Transformation has been the idea from the start, and her favorite part of the job is still helping passionate owners turn vision into reality. Read Christy's story.

faq.q: How much does restaurant consulting with Monarch cost?
faq.a: Every engagement is scoped to your restaurant. After the walkthrough, you get a written plan with priorities, budget, and timeline, and nothing starts until you approve it. The free AI assessment is a good first look at your gaps.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: It depends on what we're building, and your written plan sets the timeline before work starts. For scale, our private dining club project in Vail went from first line of code to opening in about seven months.

faq.q: How does your software fit with my POS?
faq.a: It runs alongside your existing POS, so your team keeps ringing in orders the way they do today. On bigger projects we can also coordinate POS onboarding and hardware timing, and build POS lessons into your training academy.

faq.q: What do I need to provide?
faq.a: Time for the walkthrough, plus what you already have: recipes, SOPs, your handbook, menus, brand files, and vendor contacts. We write and build from there, and you review and approve each piece.

faq.q: Do you work with single restaurants or only groups?
faq.a: Both. We work with single independent restaurants and large multi-location projects. The process stays the same, and the plan scales to fit.

faq.q: Is Monarch a restaurant management company?
faq.a: We're a consulting and build partner. You and your team keep running service and making the calls, while we build and set up the systems behind it: software, training, marketing, scheduling, and sourcing. Then we stay on for support.
